title: Investigate drift reporting for delegated child sessions and workspaces other than the measured one
outcome: Undetermined in the re-audit for w-83754500a736: only one place is measured per grant (engram_turn_observations.rs:601-604), so drift in a delegated child's worktree, or in a second workspace a turn touches, may never reach the store as an inter_turn_change. Establish what is measured and reported for delegated children and for any extra workspace, and file each confirmed gap with its reason.
acceptance: A note records, with file:line citations and a test or a recorded run where behaviour is claimed, what is measured and what reaches the store for (1) a delegated child session's own worktree and (2) a second workspace a turn modifies; each confirmed gap is filed as its own item with its reason, or the note shows there is none.
